partialText: An image gallery is a nice example of AIM, where the larger version of an image can "morph" out from the smaller one when opened, and back in when closed.

title: Flexbox Masonry Layout (Explained with Math)
partialText: Flexbox has a very specific algorithm for determining how to deal with remaining (or lack of) space in a row. Let's use actual math to understand it then apply it to a masonry layout.
